<PAGE>
> Agent Foundry Orchestrator E2E tooling - description of the 99-af-e2e fixture area.

`99-af-e2e/` holds throwaway artifacts of governed-write E2E probes run by the Agent Foundry Orchestrator test harness. Nothing here is curated knowledge: files in this area exist only for the duration of a probe run and are of no value once the run ends.

The governance behavior of this area is intentional. Paths under `99-af-e2e/` match none of the L2 path rules in `policies/permissions.json`, so under the most-specific-path-wins classification fallback the policy evaluator classifies write targets here as L3-governed, and L3 always resolves to `human_required` with no auto-downgrade. Publication into this area therefore exercises a real Human Gate: a candidate targeting `99-af-e2e/af-rc3-gate-probe.md` cannot be auto-published even when independent review passes, which is exactly what the gate probe is meant to verify.

Cleanup is a full fixture reset via `fixtures/make-governed-fixture.sh`, which rebuilds the fixture vault from scratch. Probe artifacts left behind by a run are cleared by that reset, not by per-file deletion.
</PAGE>
